svg.title: The cascade of controls that decides which Dataverse data reaches Work IQ, with Cedar's values
svg.desc: Four gates from left to right, each of which must allow the data. Gate 1, tenant, in the Microsoft 365 admin center under Copilot settings: Dataverse data available in Microsoft 365 Copilot, with the choices all users (default), specific groups or no users; Cedar uses the specific group sg-cedar-workiq-pilot. Gate 2, environment, in the Power Platform admin center under Settings, Product, Features: the Work IQ switch, which turns on business skills, semantic modeling and Copilot access; on by default for new production environments from 30 September 2026 and for existing ones from November 2026, but not for trial, sandbox, developer, EEA or EU and government environments; Cedar-Dev on, Cedar-Test on, Cedar-Prod set off explicitly until the pilot gate. Gate 3, app, in the Power Apps maker portal: Enable Microsoft 365 Copilot in model-driven apps; Cedar Operations on, other apps off; a table shared by several apps stays available until every app is off. Gate 4, Dataverse security: security roles, business units, sharing and column security trim the rows to the person or app user; for example Maya's Sales Rep role has no case access, and Omar can't read subcontractor cost. Below, two controls outside the cascade: App Access Control in the Power Platform admin center blocks applications, including agentic ones, per environment, because participation settings don't stop agentic access; the Work IQ MCP server can be allowed or blocked for everyone in the Microsoft 365 admin center under Agents, Tools, and spending policies limit Copilot Credits.
